instruction: Align all text to the center in the textboxes on slides 4 and 5.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires center-aligning all text in textboxes on slides 4 and 5 (0-indexed: 3 and 4). Slide 4 has 7 textboxes, slide 5 has 2 textboxes. Evaluator checks text alignment for each textbox and provides partial credit based on the proportion of textboxes with center alignment applied.

Metric correctly compares alignment values using PP_ALIGN.CENTER enum, which matches python-pptx library semantics
Expected value 'CENTER' is semantically correct for the instruction 'Center-align all text'
Partial credit logic is appropriate: returns proportion of matching textboxes (matching_textboxes / total_textboxes)
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S) to ensure state persistence before verification
Complete coverage: evaluator checks ALL textboxes on both specified slides
